slides.texte_overlay:
weird ADHD tricks
that sound fake
(but ACTUALLY work)

put your shoes on first.

once your feet are ready,
your brain accepts that
we're actually leaving today

leave one task half done
on purpose at night.

starting tomorrow is way easier
when you're just finishing something

do the boring task
somewhere new.

a different chair, a café, the floor.
new places give your brain
the novelty it's craving

count down out loud.
"5, 4, 3, 2, 1, up."

it sounds silly but it gives
your brain a starting line
instead of a negotiation

keep a "brain dump" page
next to you while you work.

every random thought goes there
so your brain stops bringing it back
every 5 minutes

eat the same breakfast
every day.

one less decision in the morning
means more energy left
for the ones that matter

i post ADHD tricks
that actually work for me.
